newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch minister to defend Maastricht expansion plan.
newsitem.headline: Dutch minister to defend Maastricht expansion plan.

text.p: Dutch transport Minister Annemarie Jorritsma on Wednesday will defend her decision to give a green light to the expansion of Maastricht Aachen airport.
A spokeswoman for the Dutch Ministry of Transport said Jorritsma expects a parliamentary debate on the expansion plan to be initiated by a member of the environmental party Groen Links.

Other parties, including the Dutch labour party PvdA, have been critical of the plan to permit 950 night flights a year at the Netherlands' most southerly airport, and to give the airport operating company permission to build an entire new north-south runway.

The Transport Ministry said the debate is scheduled for the morning session of the Dutch parliament but could not predict how long it would last or how many questions will be tabled. But government sources have tipped the debate will be heated. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
